withAuth options accept plan gating. Change:
  withAuth(handler, { domain: 'x', action: 'R' })
to:
  withAuth(handler, { domain: 'x', action: 'R', minPlan: '<from PLAN-MATRIX.md>' })
Only add minPlan to routes listed in the matrix group for this task. No logic edits.
